verdict.rationale: Keycloak's own Authorization Services documentation describes resource-level authorization. It covers protected resources, policies evaluated through UMA permission tickets, a Protection API, and user-managed resource access. Policy types documented beyond simple roles include role-based and JavaScript-based policies, and the site explicitly positions these services as going beyond role-based authorization. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the policy engine works in practice, and evidence of relationship-based (ReBAC/graph-style) modeling rather than only policy-based rules.
